Package index

Sequence Assemblies & phylotaR Import

Setup local taxonomic databases, pull orthologous sequence clusters via phylotaR, and retrieve GenBank metadata.

assemble_ingroup_phylotar()
Assemble Ingroup Sequence Clusters via phylotaR Similarity Mining
assemble_outgroup_phylotar()
Assemble Outgroup Sequence Clusters via phylotaR
fetch_genbank_metadata()
Fetch GenBank Sequence Metadata via NCBI Entrez Utilities

Taxonomic Cleaning & Reconciliations

Verify nomenclatural spelling, audit duplicates, and reconcile species names against accepted botanical checklists.

clean_taxonomic_names()
Reconcile and Validate Taxonomic Nomenclature
integrate_and_clean_markers()
Final Marker Integration and Taxonomic Cleaning

Multiple Alignment, DECIPHER Cleaners, & Masking

Infer positional homology using MAFFT and refine nucleotide alignments with DECIPHER automated masking.

run_mafft()
Infer Positional Homology via MAFFT Alignment
run_alignment_pipeline()
Execute Complete Alignment and Gap-Masking Pipeline
run_joint_realignment()
Perform Joint Realignment Across Integrated Ingroup and Outgroup Sequences

Locus Quality Control & Saturation Screening

Detect sequence length outliers and evaluate substitution saturation regressions across orthologous markers.

run_marker_screening()
Screen Locus Alignments for Substitution Saturation and Informativeness

Concatenation and Partitioning Maps

Concatenate locus alignments end-to-end into a supermatrix and define genomic partition coordinates.

run_concatenation_pipeline()
Concatenate Locus Alignments and Build Partition Coordinate Maps

Phylogenetic Inference & Constrained Search

Evaluate nucleotide substitution models (ModelTest-NG) and infer maximum-likelihood phylogenies (RAxML-NG) guided by constraint scaffolds.

preprocess_partitions()
Preprocess Partitions and Validate Alignment Syntax
run_modeltest_ng()
Evaluate Nucleotide Substitution Models via ModelTest-NG
build_constraint_scaffold()
Synthesize Multifurcating Monophyly Constraint Scaffold
calculate_ml_tree()
Infer Maximum-Likelihood Phylogeny under Constrained Search
calculate_rf_distances()
Compute Robinson-Foulds Distances Across Maximum-Likelihood Trees
generate_bootstrap_script()
Generate HPC SLURM Batch Script for Parallel Bootstrapping
run_local_bootstraps()
Generate Non-Parametric Bootstrap Trees Locally
collect_bootstraps()
Collect and Concatenate Parallel Bootstrap Tree Outputs
check_bs_convergence()
Check Bootstrap Convergence Criterion in RAxML-NG
calculate_temporal_bootstraps()
Estimate Temporal Bootstrap Replicates Constrained to Best ML Topology
map_branch_supports()
Map Transfer Bootstrap Expectation (TBE) Support Values onto Reference Phylogeny

Divergence Time Estimation & treePL Automation

Automate treePL penalized-likelihood cross-validation and estimate divergence time chronograms over temporal bootstrap cohorts.

rescale_tree()
Rescale Branch Lengths of a Phylogenetic Tree
run_treePL()
Estimate Divergence Times via treePL Wrapper
run_treePL_direct()
Run treePL Executable Directly
automate_treePL()
Automate treePL Divergence Time Estimation Pipeline Across Bootstrap Cohorts

Topological Validation & Tree Space Projections

Quantify topological congruence across comparative trees using Robinson–Foulds distances and multidimensional tree-space projections.

validate_phylogenies()
Comparative Tree-Space Projection and Topological Validation Pipeline

Publication Integration & Clade Summaries

Map branch support values, collapse poorly supported nodes into soft polytomies (integrate_publication_tree), and export figures.

integrate_publication_tree()
Render Final Publication Figures and Registry

IUCN Conservation Metadata Integration

Extract threat metrics and habitats via rredlist and apply standardized IUCN color scales to phylogenetic trees.

get_iucn_data()
Fetch IUCN Red List Metadata via rredlist API
scale_fill_iucn()
Standardized IUCN Category Color Scale for ggplot2
